name: story-root
comment:workspaces: Only the example story is a workspace; runtime-created stories resolve @story/* through their own tsconfig.json.
comment:scripts:dev: `--exclude story-root` stops a pasted foreach line from re-running this script (yarn's self-guard keys off npm_lifecycle_event). No `-t`: it would deadlock once a dependency gains a watch-mode dev script.
comment:scripts:typecheck: Each story has its own @story/types universe, so stories are typechecked one by one.

scripts.dev: yarn workspaces foreach -Apvi --jobs unlimited --exclude story-root run dev
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && node scripts/typecheck-stories.mjs
scripts.build: yarn typecheck && yarn workspace @story/single-engine build && yarn workspace @story/visualizer-client build && yarn workspace @story/visualizer-landing-page build && yarn workspace @story/multi-engine-client build

comment:dependencies: jsdom has no direct import: it is Vitest's DOM environment.
comment:resolutions: A second React copy breaks hooks; vite is pinned so Vitest does not nest a newer Vite than the apps build with.
